claim: In the matching retail DLL, the parameterless Referee.CheckStartRefereeing overload (0x060050A0) has an exact 123-byte body and exactly one direct DLL caller. It loads MatchMain.inst, returns when Referee.State is greater than raw 5, returns when MatchMain.isMatchEnd is nonzero, and returns when MatchMain.isRoundEnd is nonzero. Otherwise it scans raw player indices 0 through 7. For each index it resolves PlayerMan.inst.GetPlObj(index), skips when the returned object converts false, skips when Player.isSleep is nonzero, and otherwise calls the separate Boolean overload Referee.CheckStartRefereeing(Int32 pl_idx) token 0x060050A1 with that same raw index. If the Boolean overload returns true, the outer method returns immediately; otherwise the scan continues. After index 7 it returns. The only direct DLL caller of token 0x060050A0 is FACT-0074 Referee.UpdateReferee at IL+0x005C.
